milestone: Extend Rotation from Image/Graphics to Text content
slice: Direct follow-up: 'also add rotation to text, and graphics in builder.' Investigated methodically before implementing: Graphics (Shape variant) already had a fully-wired graphicRotation field end to end -- confirmed via a sanity re-check, not left unverified; a plain uploaded Graphics image deliberately stays unrotatable, matching its own pre-existing 'no Fit control either' scope boundary, a disclosed design choice, not a gap. Text had genuinely nothing at every layer: no textRotation property, no rotation handling in _syncUniversalContent's text mirror block (projectModel.js), no rotation handling in EngineV2Runtime.paintLayer's text branch (engineRuntime.js) unlike its own sibling Decoration branch right below it, no rotation field in builder.js's compiled text Layer Pack entry, and -- a genuinely new finding beyond the Image-rotation precedent -- root Studio's own renderer/slideRenderer.js's _layerDrawText only ever read a Story-Author override (ov.rotation), never any Theme-Author-authored compiled rotation field at all, so even a perfectly correct compile step would have had nowhere to land in the real Reader-facing renderer. Fixed at five links: experienceSchema.js gained textRotation:0; _syncUniversalContent's text mirror block now carries rotation:props.textRotation||0 on both the update and create paths; engineRuntime.js's _paintLayer text branch gained the identical translate-rotate-translate wrapping its Decoration branch already used; builder.js's text compile branch now carries rotation:layer.rotation||0 inside the compiled text:{} object; root Studio's _layerDrawText was rewritten so its rotation resolution reads t.rotation (the compiled base) as its default, with a genuine Story-Author override (ov.rotation) still correctly winning over it when present -- the exact ov-overrides-t precedent every other field in this function already follows, byte-identical to before for any object with neither set. worldBuilderApp.js gained a Rotation field group in the Text section's Inspector after its Transform fields, plus rotation:props.textRotation||0 wired into the isolated Experience Studio preview's own live paintLayer call. tools/world-builder/ (v1) deliberately left untouched -- confirmed its own builder.js has an identical Fidelity-fix-era text compile branch (kept in lockstep once, for the anchor/alignment fix only) but no rotation-authoring mechanism anywhere in its projectModel.js for any object kind, so adding a compile-time field for a capability v1 has no UI to author would be scope creep. Verified via a new 22-assertion Playwright suite across 5 parts mirroring the Image-rotation feature's own verification shape: (1) real UI drive confirming the mirrored Scene Layer's rotation field reflects the real slider value and survives an unrelated Opacity edit; (2) EngineV2Runtime.paintLayer ctx.rotate spy confirming a genuine rotate call for a rotated text layer and zero calls for rotation:0; (3) a real compile-time test through the actual Experience mirror confirming builder.js carries rotation through to the compiled text.rotation field with alignment/content Fidelity fields unaffected; (4) root Studio's renderer/slideRenderer.js confirming ctx.rotate fires with the compiled base rotation when no override exists, AND that a real Story-Author override correctly wins over it when both are present; (5) a Graphics Shape rotation sanity re-check confirming it's unaffected. All 22 assertions passed on the first run. Full regression: both goldenBuild.js suites (30/30 each) and the existing Collection Phase 2/4/5 + scene-dropdown-repro3 Playwright suites all pass unchanged. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Creator Governing Rules change; confined to tools/world-builder-v2/js/services/{experienceSchema,engineRuntime,builder}.js, tools/world-builder-v2/js/projectModel.js, tools/world-builder-v2/js/worldBuilderApp.js, and root Studio's renderer/slideRenderer.js.
